title: [spec-gap][R-12-048] SOS origin-signature enforcement diverges 3-way; origin seq gate missing in C/Rust; origin address synthesis vs AddrForKey
description: spec/12-apps.md:707-744 (18.4.1 MUSTs): (1) invalid/missing SOS origin signature MUST be silently dropped — C conforms (-ENOENT, coap_server.c:467-502), Python returns 4.01 (emergency.py:235-251), contradicting sos_signature.json:30 (error_response:false); (2) per-origin monotonic Origin Sequence gate MUST be enforced — Python yes (sos_origin.py:182-209), C gate exists (sos_resource.c:92-96) but is never called from sos_post (coap_server.c:449-528), Rust has none; (3) all three stacks synthesize the transcript origin IPv6 as 0200:0000:...:<IID> (emergency.py:247, coap_server.c:498-499) instead of the node's primary AddrForKey /128 required by spec ('origin IPv6 address is the originator's 16-octet primary 02xx address preserved end to end') and by decision upstream-yggdrasil-addressing. Also: C rate limiter is single-source global state, not per-origin (coap_server.c:447). Note: sos_signature.json is descriptive-only (placeholder keys); only Rust pins a real transcript digest (sos_origin.rs:160-173). Placement: convergence across python emergency.py, C coap_server.c sos_post + sos_resource.c, rust lichen-node SOS RX path; regenerate sos_signature.json with real pinned key/signature bytes.
close_reason: All 5 children closed and landed: .1 C per-origin seq gate + per-origin rate limiter (51b45d3d71); .2 C origin_ipv6 = AddrForKey(pubkey) (51b45d3d71); .3 Python silent-drop + AddrForKey origin (6566c1d869); .4 Rust per-origin monotonic seq gate + AddrForKey helper (15386220f4 + tail-batch fixes); .5 sos_signature.json regenerated with real pinned Schnorr48 key + AddrForKey transcript (fc4841402d). The 3-way divergence (silent-drop semantics, seq gate, origin address synthesis) is resolved in all three stacks, and the shared oracle now pins real crypto cross-verified Python->Rust.
